Premier Event Venue

Banquet Halls & Conference Venues in Hubballi

Host your events in style at our premier halls. Perfect for corporate conferences, weddings, receptions, and grand gatherings in Hubballi. Our facilities are designed to handle both intimate business meetings and large-scale celebrations with equal grace.

Gala Vista features two dedicated, versatile spaces: Gala Vista I, tailored for grand weddings, receptions, and family celebrations; and Gala Vista II, purpose-built for business conferences, seminars, and corporate meetings.

1 / 3
Grand Celebrations

Gala Vista I — Grand Banquet Hall

Designed for grand celebrations, weddings, marriage receptions, engagement ceremonies, and festive family reunions. The hall provides an opulent atmosphere, elegant lighting, and seamless coordination to make your special moments unforgettable in Hubballi.

  • Ideal for weddings, receptions & milestones
  • Secure basement parking for all guests
  • On-site catering and banquet management support
1 / 3
Corporate & Professional

Gala Vista II — Conference & Event Space

Tailored for corporate conferences, business presentations, seminars, executive boardroom meetings, and corporate training programs. Located within our business hotel on Gokul Road, Gala Vista II provides professional surroundings with high-speed Wi-Fi and modern event infrastructure.

  • Purpose-built for corporate seminars & conferences
  • High-speed Wi-Fi and presentation connectivity
  • Adjacent business center and hotel room blocks
